evidence.result: No correctness or security defect found. Express 5 async handlers propagate DomainError to the shared handler; error.directory reaches ApiError.details; 204 handled by readJson; path comes only from the DB record and is checked (plain name, direct child of Downloads, regular file via lstat); openers use argv arrays without a shell.

messages.text: Manual checks to run after integration (verification_not_run above, OQ-ra-1): in the Play dev-link on Windows, open a company -> Relatórios -> Exportar PDF, then 'Abrir PDF' (default reader opens the file) and 'Mostrar na pasta' (Explorer opens Downloads with the file selected). Repeat on macOS when a machine exists ('open' and 'open -R').

Run `pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts tests/api/fileRoutes.test.ts` once reportService registers the saved file. Its contract: after saveFile(), insert via createGeneratedFileRepository(prisma).insert({ companyId, kind, fileName, directory, createdAt: now() }) and answer { fileId, fileName, directory }; if the insert fails, delete the saved file and throw write_failed. kind values: diagnosis_pdf, evolution_pdf, portfolio_pdf, questionnaire_html.

IF-002 is live: POST /api/files/:fileId/open and /reveal answer 204 (body never read). Errors: 404 file_not_found (no record, id longer than 64 chars, file gone or not a regular file, record outside the app's Downloads folder, or non-plain file name); 500 open_failed with message 'Não foi possível abrir. O arquivo está em {pasta}.' and error.directory. Client: src/api/filesApi.ts exports openSavedFile(fileId) and revealSavedFile(fileId).

createApp accepts an optional systemOpener (default createSystemOpener(), the real one); server/main.ts passes it explicitly. Any e2e/Playwright bootstrap that clicks 'Abrir PDF' or 'Mostrar na pasta' must inject a fake SystemOpener (interface in server/files/systemOpener.ts), or it will launch the real reader or Explorer.

tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts resetData() does not delete generated_files (verified: no reference to generatedFile). Rows with companyId null survive the company deleteMany. tests/api/fileRoutes.test.ts clears them itself (beforeEach, line 140). Consider adding prisma.generatedFile.deleteMany() to resetData so reportRoutes and portfolio tests do not see leftovers.

scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs (outside this unit) passes with the new migration but does not seed generated_files (verified: no reference). Optional: seed one generated_files row so the update path proves the table survives the synthetic companies rebuild.

generated_files.company_id is nullable (still ON DELETE CASCADE), as the plan's 'company_id com cascata' allows: the portfolio PDF (Phase 2) belongs to no single company. Not a defect; recorded so the portfolio unit does not assume a required company.
